title: Aziiata Septel — silver glass columns, pill video, cards fading into white
note: A fashion designer's portfolio on white, behind which broad vertical bands of silver and pale blue (#A0A2A3 to #E6E9F7) run like the ribs of frosted glass or a chrome curtain, with a soft horizontal lens flare. Over it: a pill-shaped (fully rounded) video of her sitting on an office chair, two white dots blurred with backdrop-filter: blur(4px), and photo cards with 32px corners whose edges are masked to fade into white. Captions are small grey mono ("Representation of national minority cultures", "Exit through the gift shop", "10 degree"). Thin white contour drawings of tangled hair cross the whole page. Built in Readymag with SVG masks. Worth reusing: a material behind the work (glass, chrome) instead of flat white, and masked fades so images melt into the page.
